reference.role: Inspected style reference: hand-painted 2.5D fantasy brass machinery, cream stone, teal accents, dark plum outlines. Described in generation prompt.

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent game equipment texture atlas.
Primary request: Create exactly TEN DISTINCT FULLY FINISHED EMPTY BOOTS / SHOES as polished hand-painted 2.5D physical equipment objects. Canvas exactly 2560 px wide × 1024 px high, organized invisibly into FIVE equal 512×512 columns × TWO equal 512×512 rows. Strict reading order below. This is ONE atlas image, not a UI.
Style/medium: rich hand-painted storybook fantasy / brass-industrial adventure equipment, matching an isometric fantasy game with warm cream limestone, worn brass mechanical details, teal accents, deep plum crisp ink outlines, softly painted volumetric surfaces, carefully modeled physical depth. Premium illustrated game inventory objects with three-quarter perspective, visible thick sole, side planes and empty inside opening. All 10 should be different actual construction and silhouette, not recolored copies or flat symbols.
Scene/backdrop: truly TRANSPARENT alpha 0 everywhere outside the objects. No scene, no floor, no cast shadow, no halo.
Composition/framing: one single boot or shoe representing each item, centered in its own square cell; ALL parts including toe, ankle rim, sole and attachments must fit inside the central 70% of the cell, leaving 15% blank gutters on ALL four edges. Row 1 centers x=256,768,1280,1792,2304 at y=256. Row 2 same x at y=768. Each complete object bounds within ~358×358 px. No overlap, clipping, merging or crossing cells. No visible grid or frames.
ROW 1 LEFT TO RIGHT, one item per cell:
1 (EQ41 Folded-Rim Mining Boots / 折边矿靴): a stout mining boot, broad gray steel toe, visibly OUTWARD-FOLDED warm copper ankle rim, gray work leather, warm ivory stitching, heavy textured gray sole. Clearly wide gray toe and folded copper rim.
2 (EQ42 Light-Rail Inspection Shoes / 轻轨巡检鞋): lighter low inspection shoe, slim reddish copper rail mounted along its narrow sole, LARGE WHITE shoe buckle across the instep, warm cream-gray shoe body. This is a slim low shoe visibly distinct from the mining boot.
3 (EQ43 Stoker Slag-Vent Boots / 司炉排渣靴): short industrial furnace boot of blackened iron and brown leather, solid slag collecting box integrated at its REAR HEEL, exactly THREE clearly visible orange/amber glowing exhaust slots in the rear heel box, restrained brass rivets. Internal amber material only, no glow around silhouette.
4 (EQ44 Singing-Rail Maglev Boots / 鸣轨磁悬靴): futuristic-fantasy blue rail boot, rounded COPPER RING around its ankle, a visibly SEPARATED BLUE SOLE PLATE floating a very short distance immediately below the shoe as one equipment assembly; both blue plate and upper fit in the same cell. Brass supports, pale blue-gray leather. Visible transparent gap within assembly. No external energy rays.
5 (EQ45 Frost-Tide Icebreaker Boots / 霜潮破冰靴): ice-blue winter boot with layered scalloped pearly WHITE SHELL PLATES wrapped around ankle, a strongly SERRATED ICE-BLUE SOLE. Solid carved shell texture with clear side faces; pale blue body.
ROW 2 LEFT TO RIGHT, one item per cell:
6 (EQ46 Verdigris Channel Boots / 铜蚀导流靴): copper industrial boot with a clearly visible inner-side GREEN LIQUID WINDOW and copper liquid-guiding grooves along the boot side, warm copper shell and green glass insert; orient so that the green inner-side window is plainly visible.
7 (EQ47 Oathguard Foundation Boots / 誓卫城根靴): tall SQUARE BLACK boot, blocky architectural construction, clear WHITE FOUNDATION / base-course motifs around the lower side and heavy rectangular black outsole; deep black iron and leather, ivory accents.
8 (EQ48 Faultline Rock-Press Boots / 断层压岩靴): thick boot with TWO DISTINCT STACKED BLACK ROCK SOLE LAYERS, rough chunky stone texture, conspicuous YELLOW BINDING STRAPS crossing the dark gray boot; deep structural physical side faces.
9 (EQ49 Prism Measuring-Step Boots / 棱镜量步靴): refined boot with segmented cream-gray vamp plates etched with small ruler graduation TICK MARKS (no numerals, no letters), a narrow VIOLET PURPLE HEEL, tasteful violet prism facets; clearly a real shoe with purple narrow heel and segmented measuring upper.
10 (EQ50 Windcourier Side-Fin Shoes / 逐风侧鳍鞋): slender SAND-WHITE lightweight shoe body with outward-swept AZURE / SKY-CYAN SIDE FIN, brass edging, thin but physically visible sidewall and sole. Fin is integrated into shoe, complete and unclipped.
Lighting/mood: softly directional upper-left painted highlight; self shading only; rich tactile hand-painted leather, stone, brass and shell. Warm coherent palette while honoring each individual identity color.
Constraints: EXACTLY ten equipment identities, one complete object in every cell, ALL unique and readable. EMPTY footwear only: no feet, legs, skin, body, characters or mannequin. Preserve full physical boot / shoe shape including openings. True alpha transparent exterior. Clean high quality silhouette. No lettering, numbers, labels, watermarks, UI, background, grid, cell border, decorative frame, rarity aura, particles or ground shadows. Do not add any extra objects outside the ten footwear objects.

generation_history.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the attached transparent TEN-BOOT equipment atlas.
Primary request: Correct ONLY the atlas composition and spacing. Preserve exactly the same ten distinct beautiful hand-painted physical equipment designs, materials, details, colors, three-quarter perspectives, and strict row-major order. Keep actual alpha transparency.
Canvas target: exactly 2560×1024 pixels, 5 columns × 2 rows of equal square cells. ALL TEN FOOTWEAR OBJECTS MUST BECOME MUCH SMALLER, each only about 60% of one cell width and height. The original items are too crowded. Shrink their visual footprints to 60% of the original cell footprint and CENTER each object separately in its own exact cell. Leave at least 20% completely empty transparent space along each cell's four edges. This substantial negative space is mandatory, especially between the two rows and around the outer canvas. No part of an item can enter a neighboring cell. Do not use all available canvas for the boot sizes.
Layout: FIVE objects on top row and FIVE on bottom, equidistant and precisely aligned. Top row identities left-to-right: gray mining boot with folded copper cuff; cream inspection shoe with white buckle and copper rail sole; black stoker boot with amber three-slot heel furnace box; blue maglev boot with copper ankle ring and separated blue sole plate; ice-blue boot with pearly shell ankle plates and serrated blue sole. Bottom row identities left-to-right: copper boot with green liquid window and grooves; tall square black foundation boot with white base motifs; gray boot with two black rock sole layers and yellow straps; cream prism boot with violet narrow heel and segmented ruler tick-mark vamp; sand-white windcourier shoe with sky-blue side fin.
Keep one COMPLETE boot per cell with full toe, heel, ankle opening and attachments. Keep thick soles and 2.5D volume. Retain all TEN existing identities. No new objects, no text, no numbers, no labels, no frames, no grid, no UI, no shadows, no floor. Empty footwear only, no feet or legs. Truly transparent alpha 0 outside object cutouts. Crisp clean edges without any colored alpha fringe.
generation_history.reason: Best separated compact layout; all ten complete unique physical equipment identities.

Preserve the gray mining boot copper cuff, white-buckle low shoe copper rail, three-amber-vent stoker boot, blue maglev boot separated blue sole and copper ankle ring, icy shell-plated boot serrated sole, copper liquid-window boot, black foundation boot white motifs, double black rock sole boot yellow straps, violet-heeled prism boot segmented tick-mark upper, and sand-white cyan-fin shoe, all in that order.
Clean the transparency perfectly. Background and all generous blank gutters must be EXACTLY alpha zero, with no ghost pixels, stray speckles, semi-transparent haze, halos, color fringe, glow or shadow. Use a crisp clean dark plum equipment silhouette edge and standard natural edge antialiasing ONLY immediately along the equipment outlines. Remove red/cyan/blue fringe pixels extending beyond the silhouette. Keep internal painted highlights, brass material, deep 2.5D side-face shading, openings and all attachments.
Canvas target 2560×1024 pixels. Keep five equally spaced columns, two equally spaced rows and 20% blank cell margins. No object touching another, cell boundaries, or canvas edge. Do not enlarge or rearrange any item. No frames, UI, text, numbers, labels, grid, floor, legs, feet, characters or new items. One complete isolated empty physical boot in every cell, no clipping. Transparent background, alpha zero outside the ten cutouts.

measurement.method: Pillow and NumPy measurement only, raw PNG unmodified.

validation.visual_inspection: Exactly ten distinct physical boots/shoes, with full openings, toes, soles and identity attachments. No characters, UI or text; individual ruler marks have no numerals.

limitations: Built-in generator returned raw RGBA 1983×793 despite requested 2560×1024; PNG preserved without resizing.
Threshold-16 regions are fully separate and complete, but strict minimum 15% gutters are not achieved uniformly: top-row lower margins 50–57 px, and EQ50 left margin 43 px.
5217 low-alpha pixels (alpha 1–15) outside measured regions remain in raw tool output; visible alpha at or above 16 is wholly inside the ten regions.
Colored edge fringe remains on a few silhouettes in the raw generated PNG; no image post-processing was performed.
